svg.text: THE CATACOMBS: THE HEIGHT PLAN, 12 plots going down (a proposal)
north is up · one plot = 12 x 12 squares = 42 m · room site_prebuilt_vatican_under
to the Tunnel-Way (moved to the new east wall)
to Hell (the warm wall; moved to the new east wall)
under the altar · a board fits
- - a FOUND way up (a climb, a trunk, a ladder)
┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle = a RAMP square, pointing uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk works today: no new rule.
Plot lines by district: K = The Catacombs. Dashes = a new plot. Orange dots = the ways out of the room; their squares keep today's height. A PROPOSAL: nothing is built from it until mondo says so.
